top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a discovery in which a concrete theoretical prediction (the 2011 continuum model locating a magic twist angle with flat bands) was borne out by experiment (correlated insulators and superconductivity in 2018), since reproduced by many groups and extended to other moire systems. The allocation to MacDonald, Bistritzer and Jarillo-Herrero matches prediction plus first observation, and the citation avoids claiming a pairing mechanism. P002 (optical lattice clocks, Katori and Ye) is a mature, clearly experimental achievement and a sound second choice, but I rank it below because the twisted-graphene case better fits nature supplying a clue to an idea. A prize is preferable to no award, so P000 is last.
